BookmarkedTool.title: BookmarkedTool
BookmarkedTool.description: Represents a user's bookmarked API or Maker tool in Julian OmniCore.

toolId.description: Unique identifier of the tool from the 85-tool catalog.

note.description: Optional user note or preset parameter hint for this tool.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the bookmark was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the bookmark was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

UserApiConfig.title: UserApiConfig
UserApiConfig.description: Stores a user's custom REST API base URL, header key, and preferred execution mode.

apiKeyHeader.description: Optional API key header value for custom REST server.

executionMode.description: Preferred execution mode across the 85 tools.

enableHighThinking.description: Whether high thinking mode (gemini-4-argon) is enabled by default for complex queries.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the config was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the config was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/bookmarks/{toolId}.description: Stores bookmarked tools per authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/settings/{configId}.description: Stores custom API endpoint settings per authenticated user.
